## Page 5

Sustainable Activities in Q 4/2025 - Environment
6Zen Group, in collaboration with Thai 
Namthip Coca- Cola and Westbuy 
Delivery, donated 200 reflective vests 
made from recycled PET plastic 
bottles to the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration to support street sweepers.
Zen Group participated in the assessment of its Corporate Carbon Footprint (CCF) under its flagship ZEN brand and got officially certified 
by the Thailand Greenhouse Gas 
Management Organization (TGO) on 8 Oct 2025.
On the Table has replaced bottled mineral 
water with the Rynn on- site system, 
producing high -quality still and sparkling 
mineral water while reducing plastic use and transportation to support sustainability.
Available at On the Table Central World and 
Central Ladprao.

## Page 6

Sustainable Activities in Q4/2025 - Social
7Zen group and its affiliated restaurants, 
together with the Songkhla Red Cross Chapter, assisted flood victims in Hat Yai District by providing ready -to-eat meals 
and financial aidZen Group donates to the Thai Red Cross Society to support victims of the Thai-Cambodian border situation, on 
30 October 2025
Zen Group, under ‘ Pun-Im Pun-Suk project ’, 
provided meal boxes to the public, officials, and volunteers during the Royal Cremation Ceremony of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit, the Queen Mother, at Sanam Luang during 11-17 
November 2025

## Page 7

Sustainable Activities in Q4/2025 - Governance 
8ZEN Group has been rated “AA” in the SET ESG 
Ratings 2025 for the 3rd consecutive year, 
reflecting the Company’s continued commitment to sustainable business practices and strong corporate governance standards.
This recognition underscores the Group’s 
consistent progress in environmental stewardship, social responsibility, and transparent governance, reinforcing long -term 
value creation for shareholders and stakeholders alike.
Zen Group promotes sourcing raw 
materials from local communities and SMEs to support small businesses and promote income distribution.
Zen Group operates with a strong focus on sustainability and good governance, maintaining transparent and ethical relationships with partners and customers.
The Company has continuously received 
an excellent CG assessment score from IOD for the 5
th consecutive year.

## Page 20

Business Direction 2026
22
•Thailand’s economy is forecast to grow modestly at around 1.5 –2.0% in 2026, reflecting weak 
global trade, soft export performance, and high household debt constraining domestic demand. 
•Within this environment, the restaurant and foodservice market is expected to expand by 
approximately 3 –5%, supported by tourism recovery, urban lifestyle trends, and continued 
expansion of delivery platforms. However, operators will continue to face intense competition, cautious consumer spending, and cost pressure will remain elevated.
1.Improve SSSG through CRM and promotion optimization
2.Focus on expanding profitable brands
3.Strengthen regional franchise network
4.Accelerate Manufacturing & Trading growth
5.Continue cost optimization and SG&A disciplineDriving Sustainable & Profitable Growth
